option_relations.rationale: Option A describes Strongyloidiasis with hyperinfection syndrome, which is clinically equivalent to Disseminated strongyloidiasis (Strongyloides stercoralis hyperinfection syndrome).
Option B describes Strongyloides hyperinfection syndrome, which is clinically equivalent to Disseminated strongyloidiasis (Strongyloides stercoralis hyperinfection syndrome).

Option C describes Disseminated Strongyloides stercoralis infection with ocular involvement (choroiditis), which is a more specific description of Disseminated strongyloidiasis (Strongyloides stercoralis hyperinfection syndrome).
Option D describes Strongyloidiasis hyperinfection syndrome, which is clinically equivalent to Disseminated strongyloidiasis (Strongyloides stercoralis hyperinfection syndrome).
